notes: A shallow basin on a short stem, for a garden corner or a quiet cottage. It is a solid mass, so it is never placed on the tile a resident must cross.
The voxel scene draws it through the generic prop branch of src/voxel-world.js furniture(), which is what rules.geometry records; world.js draws the same silhouette on the pixel map.
A decoration only. The water in it is drawn, not stored: it is not a resource, an ingredient or a coin.
